verses.gurmukhi: ਪਲ ਘੜੀਆ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪਹਰਿ ਥਿਤ ਵਾਰ ਗਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pal ghaReeaa moorat pahar thit vaar ganaae|

en.bdb: From moments, the gharis (a unit of time equal to 22).

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਇ ਪਖ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਬਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhui pakh baareh maeh kar sa(n)jog banaae|

en.bdb: (5 minutes), muhurat (auspicious time), the quarters of day and night (pahar – three hourstime) dates and days have been counted. Then joining two fortnights (dark- light) and twelve months have been made.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਵਰਤਾਈਆਂ ਬਹੁ ਚਲਿਤ ਬਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rutee varataieeaa(n) bahu chalit banaae|

en.bdb: Many inspiring visuals have been created through the six seasons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਵੇਦ ਅਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sooraj ik varatadhaa lok vedh alaae|

en.bdb: But as the knowledgeable persons say, the sun remains the same among these all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾਂ ਬਹੁ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan chhia dharasanaa(n) bahu pa(n)th chalaae|

en.bdb: Similiarly, four varans, six philosophies and many sects have been promulgated,
But the gurmukh understands all (and hence there should be no in-fightings).
